;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Naval Air Station Corpus Christi attack]]
**A motorist opens fire and attempts to breach the perimeter of [[Naval Air Station Corpus Christi]] in [[Texas]], injuring a [[security guard]], before being shot and killed. [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] officials determine the incident to be [[terrorism]]-related and say a second [[person of interest]] may be at large. The shooter is later identified as a [[Syria]]-born man who expressed support for [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIS]] and [[Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/injured-shooting-naval-air-station-corpus-christi-suspected/story?id=70806888 (ABC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/05/21/us/naval-air-station-corpus-christi-lockdown/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Three women are killed in a [[stampede]] in [[Colombo]], [[Sri Lanka]], during an [[United States dollar|US$]]8 cash handout at a businessman's warehouse. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/women-crushed-death-sri-lanka-stampede-8-handout-200521170739273.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] approves [[Michigan]] [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]]'s emergency declaration in [[Midland County, Michigan|Midland County]] which experienced mass flooding after the [[Edenville Dam]] failed two days ago. The order authorizes [[Federal Emergency Management Agency|FEMA]] to assist state and local officials with the emergency response. [https://nbc25news.com/news/state/president-trump-says-fema-is-in-michigan-assisting-with-flood-efforts (WEYI-TV)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The number of worldwide cases of COVID-19 surpasses five million. The [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|United States]] remains the global epicenter, accounting for approximately 31% of all reported and confirmed cases in the world. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/coronavirus-pandemic-05-21-20-intl/h_00b44ae71c08502894526c3b4a23092e (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] announces it will withdraw from the [[Treaty on Open Skies|Open Skies Treaty]] within six months, alleging continuous violations by [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-52760420 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The [[European Court of Justice]] rules that [[Government of Hungary|Hungarian authorities]] circumvented [[European Union law|EU law]] by holding [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] and [[Iran|Iranian]] [[asylum seeker]]s in unlawful detention at a camp near the [[Hungarian border barrier|Serbian border]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/hungary-illegally-held-asylum-seekers-ecj-rules/a-53431848 (DW)]
*A military court in [[Vietnam]] sentences former deputy defense minister [[Nguyễn Văn Hiến]] to four years in prison for allowing three plots of land in [[Ho Chi Minh City]] to be illegally transferred from the [[Vietnamese Navy|Navy]] to private investors. He is also stripped of his [[Communist Party of Vietnam|Communist Party]] credentials. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trial/vietnam-jails-ex-deputy-defence-minister-over-land-scandal-idUSKBN22X1NW?il=0 (Reuters)]
